'''Blackhawks''' were a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used in [[3643 BBY]] - they were used during [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]] - serving the Empire. [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Kalisch]] led a squadron of them against the [[Fastbreeder|Hex Droids]] there.
